title: ShortenedSwords
description: Resource Pack for ShortenedSwords,  & introduces Minecraft's updated textures for older versions (1.8.9).
body:
**This pack Introduces Updated Textures and New, Shortened Swords for PVP**

Version Supported is 1.8.9
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Features Include:**
1. _More detailed Shortened Swords_
2. _Updated tool sets to match Swords._
3. _Updated Textures from 1.14_
4. _Subtle Highlighted Wool_

**Not Included:**
1. _Subtle Highlighted Carpet Textures_

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
